scientific_integrity: All positive parameter cases are proved analytically using exact rational reduction and discriminants; supplied finite computations are verification aids, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only two positive symmetric shell pairs and order-one analytic Cauchy-wavelet zeros in the upper half-plane; no general four-point classification, statistical recovery assertion, or parameter-uniform noise result.
title: A semicubical cusp in the zero geometry of a four-atom Cauchy wavelet
